prompt: Extreme wide shot looking across a vast open quarry pit toward the far cliff. The far towering layered rock-strata wall holds an enormous flat fossil: the complete dark etched skeleton of a colossal horned beast pressed sideways into the grey-brown slate, a giant flat imprint flush with the cliff face, NOT a statue. Stepped quarry ledges and scattered rubble descend toward it; tiny silhouetted figures at the base make the fossil read as ENORMOUS, dwarfing everything. A thin cold blue-white mineral seam glows along the skeleton. Dusty earthen quarry, desaturated brown and grey stone palette.
